entries.reason: The current runtime rejects an assembly that is already parented as an instance when it is used as an owning nested assembly.
entries.evidence: PK_INSTANCE_create returned PK_ERROR_has_parent (28) for both construction orders tried; no nested fixture was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A runtime-supported nested-assembly ownership operation is available.

notes: The empty assembly case is verified; instance, nested assembly and transform branches require separate cases.
An assembly is validated as a PK_PART with assembly-specific instance/part counts, never as a body.
